messages:
Aisha: Heads up — capacity activation for NorthStar starts tomorrow 09:00 PT. Flagged an early-warning: autoscale didn't trigger in staging last run. Can SRE run a quick fire-drill today? Need verification of quota gating + rollback play.
Tom: On it. I ran a dry perf earlier; saw autoscaler lag with heavy concurrent KV-cache misses. Suggest three quick checks: bump min nodes, run a ramp load with a 95th-latency guard, and verify fallback routing. Scheduling a 30m load test at 16:00 PT. Command I'll run:
```
loadtest --target northstar --model rtx-1b-q4 --concurrency 400 --rps 600 --duration 00:30:00
```
Ken: Quick customer context — NorthStar will do a controlled ramp: 20% -> 100% traffic shift. Their renewal is in ~6 weeks, so we should capture perf anomalies and token-cost delta. Recommend canary policy: route 10% to fallback model when latency > 350ms over a 5m window; auto-roll back after 2 consecutive windows.
Priya: From account side — client ok with 16:00 PT window, asks that we record the session and share perf traces + a token-cost estimate. Also wants a short enablement doc for their infra folks.
Aisha: Great. Tom please add notes to the runbook and post perf traces. Ken, can you draft a 1-pager on canary thresholds and SLA expectations? I'll keep renewal_risk=false for now but will escalate if regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
CapacityBot: loadtest scheduled: 16:00 PT today — run id 98321 — status: pending. Use `/capacity status 98321` to follow. :rocket:
Tom: Quick datapoint from the dry run — KV-cache cold starts added ~120ms to the tail. Plan: pre-warm prefix cache with the script below before activation to reduce tail latency:
```
python prewarm_cache.py --target northstar --prefixes-file prefixes.txt --parallel 8
```
Aisha: Let's run prewarm at 15:30, test at 16:00, and then a quick warm-up retest at 16:45. Abort criteria: 95th latency > 400ms or autoscale not adding nodes within 3m. If aborted, fallback to the lighter model and notify customer. Postmortem owner: Ken. Priya to coordinate customer comms. I'll check in 1h. :rotating_light:
Priya: Noted. I'll send a calendar invite + a short checklist to the customer with contact points and expected SLOs.
Ken: I'll prep rollback commands, a canary policy snippet, and a canned on-call message. Putting links in the runbook.
Tom: All set on infra side. Will post Grafana dashboard + traces link in this thread after the run.
Aisha: Thanks team. Running checklist: prewarm -> loadtest -> verify autoscale -> canary -> update billing estimate. Keep updates here.
